data.name: Gideonas
data.long_meaning: Gideon is a Hebrew name derived from the word yadon, which means 'a father'. In the Old Testament, Gideon is a powerful warrior and judge of Israel who delivers his people from the Midianites. God chose Gideon to be a leader despite his initial doubts and weaknesses. Gideon's faith and bravery led him to defeat the Midianites with only 300 men, using torches hidden in jars to confuse the enemy. This story is a testament to God's power and faithfulness in providing victory against seemingly insurmountable odds.
data.spiritual_meaning: Gideon's name represents God's strength and provision in the face of adversity.

in_hebrew.name: גידאונס
in_hebrew.meaning: גדעון הוא שופט ומנהיג גדול בישראל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם גידאונס נגזר מהשם העברי גדעון, שפירושו גדעון הוא שופט ומנהיג גדול בישראל. השם גדעון מורכב מהמילים גד ו-עון, שפירושם כרת או חיתוך, ומכאן שמשמעות השם גידאונס היא כורת או חיתוך, וגם שופט ומנהיג.

in_greek.name: Γιδεώνας
in_greek.meaning: Γιδεώνας ο ισχυρός κριτής και ηγέτης
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Γιδεώνας προέρχεται από το εβραϊκό όνομα Γεδεών, που σημαίνει Γιδεώνας ο ισχυρός κριτής και ηγέτης. Το όνομα Γεδεών αποτελείται από τις λέξεις γεδε και -ών, που σημαίνει κόπτης ή κοπής, και από εδώ το Γιδεώνας σημαίνει κόπτης ή κοπής, αλλά και ισχυρός κριτής και ηγέτης.

in_latin.name: Gideonas
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Gideonas derivatur ex nomine hebraeo Geideon, quod significat Gideonas magnus iudex et dux. Nomen Geideon constat ex vocibus ge et -deon, quod significat abscisor vel abscisionem, et hinc Gideonas dicitur abscisor vel abscisionem, sed et magnus iudex et dux.

in_english.name: Gideonas
in_english.meaning: Mighty warrior, great judge and leader
in_english.long_meaning: The name Gideonas originates from the Hebrew name Geideon, meaning mighty warrior, great judge and leader. Derived from the Hebrew words 'ge' and 'deon', signifying cutter or cutting, Gideonas connotes strength and leadership. In the biblical context, Gideon was a prominent judge and military leader in Israel, known for his faith and courage. The name Gideonas symbolizes power, wisdom, and spiritual guidance, reflecting the values of Christian tradition.

biblical_reference.note: Gideon was a judge and military leader in Israel, known for his faith and courage in the face of adversity.

data.cultural_impact: Gideon's story has been passed down through generations, and the name has become a symbol of strength and courage in Jewish and Christian cultures. It is a reminder that even the weakest and most uncertain individuals can accomplish great feats when placed in God's hands. The name Gideon is also popular in various languages and dialects around the world, including "Gidadhoni" in Swahili, "Jideon" in Igbo, and "Judhaan" in Telugu.
data.spiritual_significance: For those given the name Gideon or bearing it as a nickname, it carries a spiritual significance that calls them to trust in God's power and provision, even when faced with daunting challenges. It serves as a reminder to be brave in the face of adversity and to rely on God for strength and guidance. The story of Gideon also highlights the importance of obedience and faith, as Gideon's initial reluctance to lead the Israelites was eventually replaced with courage and determination as he followed God's will.

historical_references.reference: Gideon is mentioned in the Hebrew Bible as a judge who led the Israelites against the Midianites. He is said to have defeated them with an army of 300 men, using torches hidden in jars to deceive the enemy. This event is recorded in the book of Judges, chapter 7.

According to the New Testament book of Judges in the Bible, Gideon is also identified as a man who personally prepared an ephod, an object of idolatrous worship, to be used by the Israelites as a ‘token of their devotion to the LORD’. This episode is recorded in Judges 8:22-27.
